text: Residents can access ClimateTwin AI instantly, without signing in.
Clear warnings help residents understand changing flood conditions near their homes.
The interactive map shows an available shelter route, with estimated walking time and distance.
As simulated flooding develops, road conditions update automatically, helping residents identify available routes.
Residents can also see current water levels and AI predictions for the next ten and twenty minutes.
ClimateTwin AI helps communities prepare earlier.
